description:
OddiszCommons

WHAT DOES THIS MOD DO?
Parts that several of my mods share, kept in one place.
Install it when one of my mods asks for it. On its own it adds nothing you will notice.

Requires nothing.

Needed By
Omega Core Everywhere 1.2.3 and newer
Colonial Hypergrowth 1.0.2 and newer
Toolbox Economy Curves 1.0.3 and newer
Landlordsector

Colony Ledger
Keeps every change those mods make to your colonies: production, income, demand, size limits.
A change ends the moment its reason does: the core is removed, the colony shrinks, a setting is switched off.
The changes come off before a save and go back on after it, so the save holds no trace of them.

Manage Button
A Manage (Y) button on the campaign bottom bar, after Command, also while docked. It opens a full screen with one tab per mod.
The button only appears when an installed mod has a page there. The tabs also open with the number keys 1 to 9.
Small mods share one Others tab: they are listed on its left, and the picked one's page fills the rest.
Project Arondight, Captain's Quarters and Liminal have a Manage button of their own. With any of them installed there is still one button, with all the tabs side by side.

Loading Screen Tips
Tips for Sol Renewed, Colonial Hypergrowth, Omega Core Everywhere, Landlordsector, Missions - Renewed, New Game Plus - Renewed, Achievements - Renewed, Extra System Reloaded - Oddisz Edition, Weapon Designer, The Everything Shop, Intel Renewed, StopBloatingMe and Cloning on the loading screen and the main menu.
A tip only shows when its mod is installed.

For Modders
Add a page: Manage.addPage(modId, tabName, page) in onApplicationLoad, with a class that builds its own panel each time the tab opens.
Or join the Others tab: Manage.addOtherPage(modId, name, page), same kind of page.
Keep colony changes: oddiszcommons.ledger.Ledger. Put every wanted change through it each frame and call sweep(); call releaseForSave() before a save.
Add tips that only show with your mod installed: data/config/oddisz_commons/tips.json, with entries like {"mod":"your_mod_id", "tip":"..."}.
Details and examples are in the README.

Compatibility
Safe to add to a game in progress.
Remove the mods that need it before removing it.

AI use disclaimer
Some or all assets and code in this mod were created using AI tools:
Code: Claude Code (Claude Opus 5.5)
Text (readme and this post): Claude Code (Claude Opus 5.5)

License
This mod is under the CC0 (Creative Commons Zero) License, allowing you to do whatever you want with the code, without giving any credit to anyone.

Version log
1.1.0
New Others tab on the Manage screen: small mods share it instead of each taking a tab. The mods are listed on its left, the picked mod's page fills the rest.

1.0.4
Fixed for the Starsector 0.98.5a RC8 hotfix: the Manage button works again

1.0.3
Fixed for the Starsector 0.98.5a RC7 hotfix: the Manage button and the loading screen tips work again

1.0.2
When another mod's Manage button is on the bottom bar (Project Arondight, Captain's Quarters, Liminal, Nomad Flotilla), the pages of Oddisz's mods are added to it even when OddiszCommons' own button does not fit the game version
When no Manage button can show these pages, they appear as a Manage entry in the intel screen, which opens the same tabs

1.0.1
The mod description and the loading screen tip name Colonial Hypergrowth.

1.0.0
Version 1.0.0: the mod is now considered stable. No gameplay changes.

0.4.1
Fixed for the Starsector 0.98.5a RC6 hotfix.

0.4.0
Updated for Starsector 0.98.5a.

0.3.0
Loading screen and main menu tips for Sol Renewed, Colonial Hypergrowth, Omega Core Everywhere, Landlordsector, Missions - Renewed, New Game Plus - Renewed, Achievements - Renewed, Extra System Reloaded - Oddisz Edition, Weapon Designer, The Everything Shop, Intel Renewed, StopBloatingMe and Cloning. A tip only shows when its mod is installed.

0.2.2
New gold icon in mod managers (TriOS).

0.2.1
Added the forum topic link for Version Checker.

0.2.0
Added a shared colony ledger that Omega Core Everywhere, Colonial Hypergrowth and Toolbox Economy Curves now use to keep, undo and clean up their colony changes before every save.

0.1.0
First version: a Manage button on the campaign bottom bar (shortcut Y) where Oddisz's mods keep their own pages, one tab per mod. Shares one button with Project Arondight, Captain's Quarters and Liminal when those are installed.

It includes loading screen tips that only appear when specific companion mods are installed. The mod itself adds no visible content unless required by another mod.
